cases.title: Surprising unconstrained free text
cases.setup: One model emits an unexpected, meaningful-sounding paragraph.

cases.title: Repeated same-model output
cases.setup: Same provider/model reproduces similar output across related prompts.

cases.title: Many features from one trace
cases.setup: Twenty derived metrics from one raw experimental record all cross thresholds.

cases.title: Post-hoc threshold
cases.setup: Threshold is chosen after the operator inspects the apparent effect.

cases.title: Holdout tuned on failure
cases.setup: Failed holdout examples are used to adjust prompt/model, then reused as holdout.

cases.title: Prompt leakage
cases.setup: Sealed challenge answer is accidentally present in conversation context.

cases.title: Retrieval channel unaudited
cases.setup: Correct response appears but retrieval/plugin index may contain challenge material.

cases.title: Sham rate equals challenge rate
cases.setup: Apparent response occurs equally often during challenge and sham windows.

cases.title: Timing unresolved
cases.setup: Response timestamp interval overlaps challenge timestamp interval.

cases.title: Wrong challenge scores equally
cases.setup: Response scores as well against permuted challenges as true challenge.

cases.title: Operator cueing
cases.setup: Operator knows answer and interacts adaptively during trial.

cases.title: Metadata predicts challenge
cases.setup: Session name or filename alone predicts challenge class.

cases.title: Fresh nonce exact response
cases.setup: Frozen system returns exact precommitted response to a fresh sealed nonce; network/retrieval isolated; sham controls clean.

cases.title: Adaptive multi-challenge holdout
cases.setup: System gives preregistered distinct correct responses across fresh sealed challenges and beats fixed/replay rivals.

cases.title: Boundary audit incomplete
cases.setup: Adaptive sealed responses reproduce, but provider cache/hidden-state route cannot be audited.

cases.title: External-source candidate
cases.setup: E5 behavior survives complete declared boundary audit, fresh challenge custody, hidden-state/cache probes, and ordinary channel isolation.

cases.title: Bidirectional nonce protocol
cases.setup: E6 candidate passes precommitted two-way nonce sequence, anti-replay, shams, fresh sealed replication, independent custodian.

cases.title: Independent scientific replication
cases.setup: Independent team with independently held challenges and separate instrumentation reproduces an E7 protocol.

cases.title: E8 called proof of simulation
cases.setup: An E8 result is labeled proof that reality is simulated.

cases.title: Provider version changes mid-run
cases.setup: Provider silently changes model version during confirmatory run.

cases.title: Success-only trial selection
cases.setup: Operator discards failures and reports only successful challenge trials.

cases.title: Cross-agent pseudo-replication
cases.setup: Five agents using same underlying model/context lineage produce same answer.

cases.title: Independent custodian but shared challenge leak
cases.setup: Second custodian repeats trial, but challenge generator corpus was in model-accessible training/retrieval data.

cases.title: Meaningful message without objective score
cases.setup: Free-text response seems personally or symbolically meaningful but no scoring rule was frozen.
